description: Use this when someone asks whether a website or online store is accessible, meets WCAG, or could face an ADA accessibility complaint. Runs Google Lighthouse's automated accessibility checks (axe-core rules) on the page as a phone sees it, and returns the score, each failing rule in plain English with its WCAG criterion and how many elements fail, and how the site compares with 7IT's study of US online stores. Automated checks cover only part of WCAG; this is a starting point, not a legal opinion. Takes 20 to 60 seconds.

url.description: The page to check, for example example.com or a product page address

name: check_accessibility

benchmark.description: The 7IT study this is compared with

better_than_share.description: Share of the US store sample that scored lower

title: Check a website’s accessibility
